messages.subject: Assistance needed on writing Deducer::descriptive.table
parts:
Hi all,

I am having some formatting/syntax issues writing the results of running a simple Analysis>Descriptives form a data set.

This is working

> FlightXY<- Deducer::descriptive.table(vars = d(X,Y) , strata = d(Date,Time),data= Flight_tracks, func.names =c("Mean"))
> write.table(FlightXY,'C:/CLN_Bat Project/T.txt',sep='\t')

However the written text file does not include the strata data and times.

The written file has this format:
Mean Mean.1 Mean.2 Mean.3 Mean.4
X 712237 716394.4 733617.3 706525
Y 3721762 3693663 3729273 3709741


If I run the Analysis>Descriptives pull down menu:

> descriptive.table(vars = d(X,Y) ,
+ strata = d(Date,Time),data= Flight_tracks,
+ func.names =c("Mean"))
The console shows this so it is stratified by dates and times.
$`Date: 02-07 Time: 00:00 `
     Mean
X  712237
Y 3721762

$`Date: 02-10 Time: 00:00 `
       Mean
X  716394.4
Y 3693663.5

$`Date: 02-13 Time: 00:00 `
       Mean
X  733617.3
Y 3729272.7

$`Date: 02-15 Time: 00:00 `
     Mean
X  706525
Y 3709741

How can I write the results to include the stratified grouping lables?

Tnx

Bruce
